selection_evidence.boundary: Official cumulative/weekly platform metrics, not sales/subscriptions or a current rank position.
Original and sequel are different works. Absence refers only to the observed overview, not every category or historical list.

count_policy.normalization: HTML entity decoding; NFC; CRLF normalized; paragraph edges trimmed; paragraphs joined by two LF
count_policy.raw_sha: SHA256 UTF8 of normalized original extracted paragraph text, before author-note cleaning; not raw HTTP bytes
count_policy.clean_sha: SHA256 UTF8 of normalized cleaned prose
count_policy.count_exclusions: UI, heading, metadata, comments and ads outside div.content excluded structurally. Explicit trailing PS and edge parenthesized author requests removed by documented regex; unmatched suspected notes are flagged.
count_policy.normalization_boundary: Research extraction uses NFC. Target tool need not normalize; only Unicode L/N category counting is shared. Platform count algorithm is not established.

access_policy: Official public pages only, no login, decryption, CAPTCHA solving, proxy or identity rotation. First challenge/paywall/truncation stops the sequential collection.
